skill_name: Construct a research study to compare the effects of meditation and exercise on anxiety levels.
workflow: The objective of this research study is to compare the efficacy of meditation and exercise in reducing anxiety levels. Participants will be randomly assigned to either a meditation, exercise, or control group. The mediation group will be asked to practice meditation for 15 minutes per day for 3 weeks.
